title.narrative: Title II - Development Food Security Activity in Karamoja, Uganda, Apolou

description.narrative: With its FFP-supported Development Food Security Activity targeting approximately 310,000 people, a USAID Implementing Partner aims to strengthen and enhance households ability to sustain food and nutrition security. The Implementing Partner interventions are structured to achieve four interrelated objectives: inclusive and effective governance; nutrition security for adolescent girls, children younger than five years of age, and pregnant and lactating women; the reduction of WASH-related diseases; and improved livelihood and incosupport.
